decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt on mango mousse sits close to the core yogurt range and carries visible public recognition, so management will continue it despite no recent website mentions.

The Abendbrotkäse was publicly presented as a flagship of the cheese direction, and that visible commitment leads management to persist with it and attribute any weak sales to temporary market conditions.

The semi-hard cheese wheel needs little extra investment and fits the established offer, but it has less visible commitment than B, so the risk of a portfolio cleanup is higher, though keeping it remains more likely.
